beats: Hook: hardware does only one- and two-qubit gates; a chemistry program needs a rotation that acts on three qubits at once; it turns out all it needs is whether an odd number of them are 1 (line_qc_build_molecule). Same cast as QC05-05: the planner and the mover.

Z1Z2Z3 is diagonal: +1 for even parity, -1 for odd, like a stairwell light with three switches: flip any one and the lamp changes, so the lamp shows the parity (Q25-06 52:53-57:53, clip 56:05-56:30 "it's doing a parity check"; line_qc_build_stair_switches).

exp(-i theta Z1Z2Z3) = a CNOT ladder gathers the parity into one qubit, Rz turns it, the mirror ladder hands it back (57:55-64:20; reuse line_whisper_line for the ladder and line_temp_knob for the turn; pays off QC03-02's chain vs tree).
Pauli strings in exponential vs circuit form: synthesis is easy for these, hard in general (72:50-74:58).

Controlled-U, Toffoli, Fredkin: the Toffoli gate flips the target only when both controls are 1, like a chest that opens only when both keys turn; it is a reversible AND, the fix promised in QC05-01, and the link from quantum to classical computing (68:45-72:50, 69:58-70:52; line_qc_build_two_keys; reuse line_qc_undo_and_bulb; Fredkin is a controlled swap: reuse line_qc_rewire_fishbowl_swap).

Its price: six CNOTs plus single-qubit gates (2 H and 7 T or T-dagger, Nielsen & Chuang fig. 4.9: check in FACTS.md) (line_qc_build_lock_inside: a fancy lock built from many simple parts; reuse line_block_towers).
Controlled-controlled-U from V with V^2 = U: two half-turns make the full turn (Q24-05 51:46-56:30; code on line_temp_knob).
Many controls: borrow work qubits, then uncompute: retrace the steps in reverse order so the helpers come back clean, nothing erased (Q24-05 57:20-62:24; line_qc_build_pebble_trail).

Decomposing a general 2^n x 2^n matrix is very challenging: a heap of jigsaw pieces with no picture on the box (clip 74:07-74:58; line_qc_build_jigsaw). Her synthesis task: does a two-qubit gate need any CNOT? controlled-U needs at most two, any two-qubit gate at most three (Barenco et al. 1995; Vatan & Williams 2004; Vidal & Dawson 2004); learning-based synthesis (Q24-05 62:45-66:32, clip 62:45-63:27).
Never tape Q25-06 s37 (the title slide of an earlier course at another institution).
Cover (line_cover_qc05_06; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the planner and the mover each turn one key in a big two-key chest; the lid springs open.
